name: AUDITMWCLOAK-fit-at-rest-alone

name: AUDITMWCLOAK-the-pose-push-as-the-binds
note: A pose's step back written into the bind as it is, not through the vertex's own blend: rest is not the bind, and a strided thigh's share turns it.

name: AUDITMWCLOAK-deep-points-chased
note: A rod far through the cloak chased: its ring creeps up to the limit pass after pass, and nothing names it.

name: AUDITMWCLOAK-one-pass
note: One pass, the loop's second never moving anything here.
why: On every body the port dresses one pass clears every pose: a pose's push is exact in that pose (its own triangle the whole way, straight back), the ease moves a fold's layers together, and no pose of CLOAK_FIT_POSES turns a bone far enough from another to turn its step back forward. The loop is kept for one that does; on these it costs a second pass that moves nothing.

name: AUDITMWCLOAK-the-ease-linear
note: The falloff (1 - (d / 8)^2) alone: the cloak round a pauldron pushed further back than the documented law, the eased vertices' mean 1.90 for 1.66.

name: AUDITMWCLOAK-no-push-limit
note: No limit a body's armour could reach: a rod forty units through the cloak is chased, and nothing names it.

name: AUDITMWCLOAK-the-cloak-not-re-skinned

new: if (false) { rows.push({ bone, slung, how: 'unresolved', by: 0 }); continue; }

name: AUDITMWCLOAK-hip-vertices-only
note: The hip pitch held to the vertices alone: a rod across the back whose ends are past the cloak's sides is called clear, its middle behind the sheet.

name: AUDITMWCLOAK-the-hip-never-unresolved
old: if (deg > pitchLimit) { rows.push({ bone, slung, how: 'unresolved', by: 0 }); continue; }
new: if (false) { rows.push({ bone, slung, how: 'unresolved', by: 0 }); continue; }

name: AUDITMWCLOAK-pitched-normals-unturned
note: A pitched blade lit as it hung: its normals off its faces by the pitch.

name: AUDITMWCLOAK-the-follow-not-hooked

name: AUDITMWCLOAK-the-gap-always-the-clearance
note: Every contact held to the whole clearance: gear that sat nearer at rest is turned at rest, the bows into the plate.

name: AUDITMWCLOAK-the-side-always-front
note: Gear behind the cloak held in front of it: slung gear pulled through the sheet.

name: AUDITMWCLOAK-slung-never-slides
note: Slung gear only turned: leaning back, the bow and the greatsword have no turn that clears.

name: AUDITMWCLOAK-the-slide-priced-inverted
old: tr[0] += u0 / slideCost; tr[1] += u1 / slideCost; tr[2] += u2 / slideCost;
new: tr[0] += u0 * slideCost; tr[1] += u1 * slideCost; tr[2] += u2 * slideCost;
note: The slide the law asks for scaled by the price twice over: a hundredth of it is taken.

name: AUDITMWCLOAK-one-round
note: The linear law taken once and its step capped to a round: the stride needs more than a round turns.

name: AUDITMWCLOAK-the-turn-uncapped
old: const wt = Math.hypot(w0, w1, w2), wl = maxTurn / rounds;
new: const wt = Math.hypot(w0, w1, w2), wl = Infinity;
note: A round turns as far as the linear law says, far from where it was taken.

name: AUDITMWCLOAK-seated-the-whole-thigh
note: Seated, the cloak keeps its thighs' whole share: the hem wraps forward under them past the knees.

name: AUDITMWCLOAK-seated-the-weight-lost

name: AUDITMWCLOAK-the-tail-under-the-cloak
note: A beast's tail counted under the cloak: the cloak chased out to the limit over it.

name: AUDITMWCLOAK-the-shield-under-the-cloak
note: A carried shield counted under the cloak.

name: AUDITMWCLOAK-the-deep-unnamed
note: A thing left through the cloak named nowhere.

name: AUDITMWCLOAK-the-unresolved-unnamed

name: AUDITMWCLOAK-the-icon-a-robe

name: AUDITMWCLOAK-a-leg-a-parents-blend

name: AUDITMWCLOAK-a-leg-a-childs-blend
